title: More than half of Americans in their 40s are sandwiched between an aging parent and their own children
summary: Overall, 25% of U.S. adults have a parent age 65 or older and have a child under 18, an adult child receiving financial support or both.

title: No Easy Fix for Bogus Respondents in Online Opt-In Polls
summary: A new study examining online opt-in polling finds that while removing bogus respondents generally improves data quality, no single method reliably solves the problem.

title: Appendix: What are bogus respondents?
summary: Survey researchers have long been concerned about respondents who answer questions inattentively. For traditional probability-based surveys, such respondents typically make up only a small fraction of those sampled. The process of selecting respondents at random from a list containing the entire population of interest means there is no way for potential bad actors to self-select […]

title: Fewer Americans use cash today than a decade ago, but many still carry it
summary: Today, 42% of U.S. adults say they don’t use cash for any purchases in a typical week. This is up from 24% in 2015.

title: Americans want transparency when AI is used in their healthcare
summary: About seven-in-ten U.S. adults (72%) say it’s extremely or very important that a doctor or other healthcare provider tells them if they’re using AI in their healthcare.

title: From Diagnoses to Treatments, Why Americans Use AI Chatbots for Health
summary: Americans use chatbots for a host of health-related reasons, from helping make diagnoses on their own to learning more about information they may have gotten from a doctor. Nearly all chatbot health users find this AI information helpful.

title: Is teen summer employment in the U.S. rebounding after a long fade?
summary: Only 35.5% of U.S. teens ages 16 to 19 worked this summer, up slightly from 2025 but far below the more than half who worked most summers before 2000.

summary: About half of Americans say they're more concerned than excited about AI, and young adults' concern is rising.
